ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router for Qiskit job dispatching, combining classical kNN exemplar indexing with quantum circuit feature embeddings to optimize runtime execution costs.
ideas.title: Qiskit Hybrid Semantic Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages Qiskit as required by the IBM Fall Fest context while mimicking the self-improving semantic routing pattern that won the Superlinked x Qwen Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated workflow engine that evaluates quantum circuit error mitigation strategies and hardware noise profiles before deployment.
ideas.title: Quantum Agent BPMN Risk Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous workflow automation with quantum reliability metrics, mirroring the structure of the UiPath AgentHack winning entry.

ideas.pitch: Enables quantum circuits to reason and optimize gate depths more efficiently during execution using reinforcement learning heuristics inspired by inference compute patterns.
ideas.title: Qiskit Inference-Time Circuit Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the hard engineering problem of noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) gate overhead, following the winning pattern of the OpenAI and Inference Time Compute hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data agent that monitors Qiskit Runtime job failures, executes an evidence gate to check calibration data, and submits verified circuit repairs via pull requests.
ideas.title: Autonomous Quantum Incident Responder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings the autonomous data engineering repair loop that won the DataHub Agent Hackathon directly into the IBM Qiskit ecosystem.

ideas.pitch: Two competing QML agents play an adversarial game to discover optimal variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) ansatzes without pre-programmed heuristic bias.
ideas.title: Adversarial Quantum State Decoupler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases truly novel multi-agent exploration in a quantum context, matching the winning self-improving adversarial agent pattern.
